criteria.title: No unresolved blocker or major findings
criteria.question: Are there zero unresolved blocker or major findings in the current production UX evidence?
criteria.why: Unresolved blocker/major counts are blocker=0 major=3.
criteria.requiredFix: Resolve blockers/majors, rerun review, and record zero unresolved blocker/major findings.

criteria.title: Every community has a complete production UX blueprint
criteria.question: Does every community or test app have a complete production UX blueprint that the review actually uses?
criteria.why: Required evidence is present and no blocking derived failures were found.

criteria.title: Reviewer can state the experience feels production-grade
criteria.question: Does the whole experience feel like a real production community app for the target users, not merely an implemented workflow harness?
criteria.why: The evidence does not contain a defensible production-grade verdict. Missing evidence fields: holisticQuestionAnswers.
criteria.requiredFix: Run the independent screenshot-first review and record a production-grade verdict grounded in screen evidence.

criteria.title: UI looks modern and intentionally designed
criteria.question: Is the UI modern, easy to use, easy to navigate, and visually appealing for the target persona?
criteria.why: Screen rows do not prove modern hierarchy, spacing, and intentional design. Missing evidence fields: holisticQuestionAnswers.
criteria.requiredFix: Remediate visual hierarchy, spacing, typography, component quality, and recapture screenshots.

criteria.title: Screens are organized around community content and jobs-to-be-done
criteria.question: Is the overall information architecture organized around community content and real jobs-to-be-done instead of workflow lists or validation surfaces?
criteria.why: Primary screens still read as workflow lists, metadata, or validation surfaces. Missing evidence fields: holisticQuestionAnswers.
criteria.requiredFix: Rebuild home and primary screens around community content and user jobs.

criteria.title: Primary workflows use domain-specific product surfaces
criteria.question: For every workflow and persona, is the primary UI a domain-native product surface rather than a generic card, checklist modal, or metadata page?
criteria.why: A primary workflow is still generic-card/checklist/modal/metadata-only. Missing evidence fields: workflowPersonaScorecards.
criteria.requiredFix: Replace primary generic surfaces with domain-native product surfaces.

criteria.title: Every screen row has fresh screenshot evidence
criteria.question: Does every reviewed screen row use fresh screenshot evidence from the app version under review, with hash, timestamp, device metadata, and app commit SHA?
criteria.why: Required evidence is present and no blocking derived failures were found.

criteria.title: Every row has visible text and screen-specific critique
criteria.question: Does every holistic and workflow/persona review answer cite visible UI/text and provide a critique specific to that screenshot and user task?
criteria.why: Visible text or non-boilerplate row critique is missing. Missing evidence fields: workflowPersonaScorecards.
criteria.requiredFix: Extract visible text and write a specific critique for each screenshot row.

criteria.title: No blocking or major layout/content defects remain
criteria.question: Does the visible UI avoid blocking or major overlap, clipping, crowding, default-scaffold, repeated-card, checklist-modal, and thin-content defects?
criteria.why: No holistic direct-question answers were supplied.
criteria.requiredFix: Fix layout/content defects and rerun the review.

criteria.title: Every implemented screen/state appears in the matrix
criteria.question: Does the screen inventory cover every user-facing screen, state, dialog, card, feed item, form, confirmation, error, empty state, persona variant, and action result?
criteria.why: Required evidence is present and no blocking derived failures were found.

criteria.title: Schema v4 JSON is complete and internally consistent
criteria.question: Is the schema v4 evidence complete and internally consistent across JSON, markdown review, matrix, remediation log, screenshots, and tracker?
criteria.why: Required evidence is present and no blocking derived failures were found.

criteria.title: Failed prior iterations have proof of remediation
criteria.question: If any prior loop iteration failed, does the remediation log prove fixes, screenshot refresh, evidence regeneration, tests, commit SHA, and zero remaining blockers/majors?
criteria.why: Required evidence is present and no blocking derived failures were found.
